scope: Reconcile the first upstream Claude Pro Fable 5.2 sample with the current launch-offer limitations.
officialTerms: Pro and Team Standard receive Fable access up to 50% of weekly usage through November 16, 2026 at 23:59 PT. After the cap or expiry, Fable uses enabled usage credits.
upstreamAssumption: The November 9 sample is extrapolated from 7 percentage points of the main weekly meter to four weeks; the adopted 782M-token estimate explicitly does not apply the 50% Fable cap.
decision: Preserve source measurements and original numeric fields. Show the historical-sample, cap and expiry caveats in the existing model/provider availability review. Do not invent a corrected monthly quota or a benchmark. Tests assert source-preserving transformations, not permanent absence of future upstream evidence.
